A student colored a whole fraction model. `text(Each part)` of the model was colored either red, yellow, or blue. The table shows the fractions of the model that were colored either red or yellow. The fraction of the model that was colored blue is missing.
problems/MDG4Ma/media/35a.jpg
The student used this work to explain that `78/100` of the model was colored blue.

:ibox:`ultext(Student Work)`

Step `text(one)`: `4/10+18/100=(4+18)/100=22/100`, so `22/100` of the model was colored red or yellow.

Step `text(two)`: `100/100-22/100=78/100` of the model was colored blue.
The student made a mistake solving the problem.
Which statement explains how to correct the error in the student's work?

A.Choice: In step `text(one)`, the denominator of `(4+18)/100` should be `10`.

B.Choice: In step `text(one)`, the fractions that were added should be `40/100+18/100`.

C.Choice: In step `text(two)`, the result of subtracting the fractions should be `88/100`.

D.Choice: In step `text(one)`, the `22/100` represents the fraction of the model that was colored blue.
